a.content: hi, we use Ledgerly for invoicing and the Xero sync has started creating duplicate invoices in Xero. every invoice we raised this week is in there twice
Sorry about that, duplicates in Xero are a pain to tidy up. Do you know roughly when it started, and whether anything changed in the Xero connection recently?
started monday i think. one of my team reconnected Xero on friday because it asked for a re-auth

That fits a known issue: if Xero is reconnected while the old token is still partly active, both connections can push invoices for a while. Our engineers are working on a fix. The quickest workaround is for me to disconnect the Xero integration from our end, clear the stale connection, and then you reconnect cleanly. You won't lose any data in Ledgerly.
ok and the dupes already in xero?

Those need voiding in Xero itself, I'm afraid, as we can't delete records in your Xero file. If it helps, I can send you a CSV listing every duplicated invoice number so you can void them in one batch.
thanks. while I have you, how do I add a new staff member who can create invoices but not see our bank details?

You'll want the "Billing clerk" role. Go to Settings > Team > Invite, enter their email and choose Billing clerk. They can create, edit and send invoices and quotes, but can't see bank details, payment settings or reports. Invites expire after 7 days if not accepted.
perfect. can they send invoices straight out or does someone need to check

By default they can send directly. If you'd like a check, turn on "Approval required" under Settings > Workflow, and anything a Billing clerk creates sits in a queue for an Admin to approve before it goes out.
oh nice, we'll turn that on
Good idea for a new starter. You can switch it off later once you're comfortable.
also our logo looks blurry on the PDF invoices, is that us or you

Usually it's the file. The PDF template scales logos to 400 pixels wide, so a small original gets stretched. A PNG at least 800 pixels wide with a transparent background tends to look crisp. SVG isn't supported on PDFs yet, unfortunately.
it's a jpeg off our website so probably tiny
That'll be it. If your designer has the original, ask for a large PNG and upload it under Settings > Branding. Existing invoices pick up the new logo next time they're downloaded.
will do. and we just registered for VAT, where do I put the number

Congratulations. Add it under Settings > Business details > VAT number and tick "Show VAT number on invoices". Then set your default tax rate to 20% under Settings > Tax so new line items pick it up. Invoices you've already sent won't change, which is what you want for your records.
do i need to do anything for making tax digital?

Ledgerly isn't an MTD filing tool itself, so VAT returns are submitted from your accounting package. Ledgerly's job is getting accurate invoices into it. I'd check the registration date with your accountant, as invoices dated before it shouldn't show VAT.
fwiw our Stripe connection is fine, payments are marking as paid no problem, it's just the xero side
Good to know, thanks. That narrows it down to the accounting sync rather than anything account-wide.
random q, is there a dark mode? I do my invoicing late at night
Not yet, sorry. It's one of our most requested features and it's on the roadmap for early next year. I've added your vote so you'll get an email when it ships.
haha fair. also my own Ledgerly bill went up this month, did prices change?

Let me check. Your plan price hasn't changed. The difference is a one-off pro-rated charge of £6.40 for the extra user added mid-month. From next month it'll just be the normal per-user price for that seat.
ah that'll be the new starter then, makes sense
Yes, that's it. The breakdown is under Settings > Billing > Invoices if you need it for your accounts.
is there a mobile app? I'd like to send invoices from site
Yes, Ledgerly is on iOS and Android. You can create and send invoices, snap receipts and check who's paid. Some settings, like templates and integrations, are desktop only.
can i take card payments on the app?

Not directly in the app at the moment. You can send an invoice with a pay link while you're with the client, and they can pay on their phone there and then, as long as a payment provider is connected.
ok good enough

recurring invoices, can they auto-send on the 1st?

Yes. Create the invoice, click "Make recurring", choose monthly and set the start date to the 1st. You can have each one send automatically or wait as a draft for you to check. They go out at 9am UK time.
